posts.title: NCDC Player of the Week: Goaltender Honors After 42-Save Shutout
posts.summary: Big congratulations to our Chiefs NCDC netminder for earning USPHL Defensive Player of the Week! A commanding 42-save performance kept the Chiefs atop the South Division standings. #ChiefsNation #NCDC #USPHL

posts.title: Youth AAA: 14U Chiefs Go Undefeated 4-0 at THF Fall Showcase
posts.summary: What a weekend for our 14U AAA boys! Four games, four statement victories at the Tier 1 Hockey Federation Fall Classic. Team defense allowed just 4 total goals all weekend behind stellar netminding. #ChiefsAAA #THF #YouthHockey

posts.title: Premier Sweep! USPHL Squad Takes Back-to-Back Battles Over Rivals
posts.summary: Six points on the weekend! Coach Firsov's Premier squad delivered a pair of disciplined, high-tempo victories at Ice Land to push their win streak to four games. Catch the boys back on home ice this Friday! #MercerChiefs #USPHLPremier

posts.title: Inside the Chiefs Training Facility: Power Skating & Video Prep
posts.summary: Behind the scenes at Ice Land: Skills Director Oktay Armgan putting our junior and youth athletes through high-tempo edge control drills, followed by tactical video breakdown in the Chiefs team theater. Discipline. Loyalty. Tradition. Excellence.

posts.title: Alumni Spotlight: Chiefs Alum Nets Overtime Game Winner in NCAA D1
posts.summary: Love seeing our former Chiefs thriving at the collegiate level! Former Mercer forward scores in dramatic 3v3 overtime to secure a big conference win. The developmental pathway works! #MercerToNCAA #ChiefsAlumni #NCAAHockey

posts.title: Goalie Academy Focus: Terry Jarkowsky Clinic in Action at Ice Land
posts.summary: Eyes on the puck! Terry Jarkowsky Goalie Academy in full session this week with our Tier 1 and Tier 2 goaltenders working on rebound tracking, crease depth, and lateral recovery. #MercerGoalies #IceLand #ChiefsNation
